verdict: Leads efficient at $10.57 each, but volume is tightening this week.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, you received 121 leads at a cost of $10.57 per lead — the most efficient rate in the recent series. This week, ad spend was pulled back 29%, which brought daily volume down and also caused Instagram reach to drop sharply; the two moves are directly connected. The bright spot is that even at the lower spend level, the last three days averaged 5.7 leads per day, which is above the prior three-day average of 3.0 — so efficiency is holding. Conversion tracking is being repaired so that your contact and appointment data reads reliably by month-end. Once that scoreboard is clean, we'll have a clearer picture of which leads are turning into booked appointments and can make budget decisions from a solid foundation.

watch_item.issue: 96 leads entered the pipeline over the last 28 days, but no appointments are showing as booked — indicating a gap between lead intake and follow-through.
watch_item.fix: Contact records and sync are being cleaned up, with a reliable dashboard live by August 31 so we can pinpoint exactly where leads are dropping off.
